notablePrerequisites: Blightsteel Colossus does not have summoning sickness. Opponents are unable to block creatures you control.
description:
Declare Blightsteel Colossus as an attacker.
Blightsteel Colossus' myriad ability triggers, creating a token copy of it attacking each other opponent.
Deal combat damage using Blightsteel Colossus and the Blightsteel Colossus tokens.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.
